title: Webb County Sheriff's Office Gives Back This Thanksgiving
excerpt: The Webb County Sheriff's Office teamed up with a state agency partner to hand out turkeys and other holiday food items to families across Laredo and Webb County on Saturday, Nov. 21.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff's Office teamed up with a state agency partner to hand out turkeys and other holiday food items to families across Laredo and Webb County on Saturday, Nov. 21.

The giveaway was about more than a meal, the Sheriff's Office said — it was about bringing joy, showing compassion, and reminding neighbors that the community looks out for one another.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar thanked the state agency partners for their generosity and support, saying Thanksgiving is a time to reflect on blessings and be thankful, and also a time to remember those who may be less fortunate and do what can be done to help. He added that sometimes the smallest act of kindness can make the biggest difference in someone's life.

At the Webb County Sheriff's Office, serving the community goes beyond daily duties, the Sheriff said — it is also about giving back, lending a helping hand, and making a positive difference for the families they serve.

Source: Webb County Sheriff's Office, Nov. 23, 2026.
